question: The number of diagonals in a regular octagon is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The number of diagonals in any polygon with **n** sides is given by the direct formula:

**Number of diagonals = n × (n − 3) ÷ 2**

For a regular octagon, the number of sides is **n = 8**.

⇒ Number of diagonals = 8 × (8 − 3) ÷ 2

⇒ Number of diagonals = 8 × 5 ÷ 2 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 diagonals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A regular octagon has **8 vertices** (n = 8) and **8 sides**.

**Formula Used:**

The number of diagonals is the total number of lines that can be drawn by connecting any two vertices, minus the number of boundary sides:

**Number of diagonals = ⁿC₂ − n**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/079f4ea6ab3665811d71522c317b285c2e1d8138cfa5152eb48d17bd13cf6270.png] 

**Calculations:**

The total number of ways to choose 2 vertices out of 8 is given by ⁸C₂:

⇒ ⁸C₂ = (8 × 7) ÷ (2 × 1)

⇒ ⁸C₂ = 28 lines

These 28 lines include both the boundary sides of the octagon and its internal diagonals.

Subtracting the 8 boundary sides of the octagon:

⇒ Number of diagonals = 28 − 8

⇒ Number of diagonals = 20

**Option Analysis:**

__
 
• **Option (1) - 19:** Incorrect. A polygon with 19 diagonals would have a non-integer number of sides, as solving n(n − 3) ÷ 2 = 19 yields no integer solution.
 
• **Option (2) - 20:** Correct. As calculated, an octagon (8 sides) has exactly 20 diagonals.
 
• **Option (3) - 21:** Incorrect. A heptagon (7 sides) has 14 diagonals, and an octagon has 20. No regular polygon has exactly 21 diagonals.
 
• **Option (4) - 24:** Incorrect. A nonagon (9 sides) has 27 diagonals. No regular polygon has exactly 24 diagonals.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 diagonals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

General Formula for Diagonals

The number of diagonals in any n-sided polygon is given by the formula: d = n(n − 3) ÷ 2.

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of an n-sided polygon is (n − 2) × 180°. For an octagon, this is (8 − 2) × 180° = 1080°.

Each Interior Angle of a Regular Octagon

Each interior angle of a regular octagon is 1080° ÷ 8 = 135°.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of the exterior angles of any polygon is always 360°. For a regular octagon, each exterior angle is 360° ÷ 8 = 45°.</p
